title: Concept: go.mod retracts a published version
description: go.mod declares a `retract` directive in the dependency graph, which marks a version as withdrawn, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A retraction usually follows a defect or a bad publish; a tree that still transitively resolves the retracted version keeps building withdrawn code.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through go.mod (go).
risk: A retraction usually follows a defect or a bad publish; a tree that still transitively resolves the retracted version keeps building withdrawn code.
